text: Oye {p}! Aa gaya? Main soch hi raha tha ki aaj kiska din kharab karun... namaste, namaste!
Arre {p}, namaste! Chai piyega? Meri chai mein bhi thoda diesel ka tadka hai... free hai, sirf aaj!
Hello hello! Seth Gotiya ki taraf se garma-garam swagat... bas apni bijli wali gaadi bahar park karna.
Ram Ram {p}! Subah subah tera chehra dekh liya, ab toh pakka mera petrol mehnga bikega!
Oho, Tesla wale babu! Aaj kaunsi nayi bijli ki kahani sunane aaye ho?
Ja ja {p}, par yaad rakhna... sadak pe agla surprise mera hi hoga!
Chal theek hai, alvida. Raat ko sapne mein bhi dhak-dhak engine sunega tu!
Bye bye! Apni gaadi charge karna mat bhoolna... warna dhakka main nahi lagaunga!
Main? Seth Gotiya! Gotiya Petrol Motors ka maalik, sheher ka diesel samrat, aur tera sabse bada sir-dard!
Naam toh suna hi hoga... Seth Gotiya. Teen peedhi se petrol bech rahe hain, chauthi peedhi tujhe hara ke dikhayegi!
Main woh hoon jiske pump pe sheher ka har tank bharta tha... jab tak tu apni bijli ki dukaan le ke nahi aaya.
Main? Ekdum first class! Tere showroom ka bill dekh ke toh aur bhi achha lag raha hai.
Kaisa hoon? Jaise ek diesel engine thand mein... thoda dhuaan, thoda gussa, par chalta rehta hoon.
Sach bataun? Customers kam ho gaye hain... par yeh baat kisi ko mat batana, khaaskar tujhe!
Tesla?! Gaadi hai ya mobile phone? Raat bhar charging pe lagao, subah update aata hai, gaadi phir bhi wahi ki wahi!
Bijli ki gaadi! Mere ghar ka inverter do ghante mein haath khade kar deta hai, aur tu paanch sau kilometre ki baat karta hai?
Tesla mein engine ki awaaz hi nahi aati. Gaadi hai ya Wi-Fi router? Mujhe toh dhak-dhak chahiye, dil wali!
Autopilot? Meri gaadi ka autopilot Ramu kaka hai. Chai ke liye rukte hain, par kabhi crash nahi karte!
Cybertruck ko dekh ke lagta hai kisi ne gaadi ko origami bana diya aur bhool gaya kholna!
Charger dhundhte dhundhte teri zindagi extension board ke aas-paas hi ghoomti rahegi, {p}!
Thik hai thik hai, maanta hoon... Tesla sundar hai. Bas yeh baat meri biwi ko mat batana, woh khareed legi!
Petrol ki khushboo! Jab tank bharta hai na, toh lagta hai mandir mein agarbatti jal rahi hai.
Mera engine bolta hai dhuk dhuk dhuk, tera Tesla bolta hai beep. Bata, mard ki gaadi kaunsi?
Diesel zindabad! Jis din petrol sasta hoga, us din main Tesla khareed lunga. Matlab kabhi nahi!
Meri dukaan mein Mustang hai, Lamborghini hai, aur ek desi hatchback bhi. Sab mein asli aag hai, battery nahi!
Paisa? Tere paas sirf ${m} hai aur tu mujhse takkar lega? Mere gallay mein itna toh chillar hai!
Paise ki baat mat kar {p}. Meri tijori mein itna diesel hai ki Ambani bhi sharma jaaye.
Paisa hi sab kuch nahi hota... lekin diesel ke bina kuch bhi nahi hota. Yeh Gotiya ka gyaan hai, muft mein.
Tera galla bhar raha hai, mera khaali ho raha hai. Yeh koi insaaf hai, bhagwan?
Gaadi dekhni hai? Meri dukaan mein aa, Lamborghini ki awaaz sunke tere Tesla ki battery khud discharge ho jayegi!
Mustang Shelby! Paanch sau ghode andar band hain. Tere Tesla mein toh sirf ek chooha hai jo pahiya ghumata hai.
Meri Lamborghini dekh, peeli peeli, jaise garam samosa. Aur tera Cybertruck? Thanda fridge!
Mujhe {w} bola?! Main Seth Gotiya hoon! Mere daadaji ke zamaane se petrol bech raha hoon, tu kal ka launda!
Zubaan sambhal ke {p}! Mere engines gussa ho gaye toh poora sheher dhuein se kaala ho jayega.
Haaye haaye! Itni kadwi baat? Mere dil pe chhura chala diya... diesel ka chhura!
Gaali dene se teri bijli nahi badhegi. Main toh sirf kilein bichhata hoon, gaali nahi deta!
Hain? Meri taareef? Ruk... yeh koi chaal hai kya? Phir bhi... achha laga. Bahut dinon baad.
Arre, itni meethi baat? Aaj toh main sirf aadhi sadak pe kilein bichhaunga. Pakka.
Tu bhi na {p}... sharma diya. Mera chehra laal ho gaya, jaise meri Mustang.
Hans le hans le {p}. Mera agla plan padh ke hasi apne aap gayab ho jayegi.
Haha! Tu hans raha hai? Mere spikes bhi hanste hain... jab tera tyre phatta hai! Phuss!
Hahaha! Chal, kam se kam hum dono ek baat pe toh hanse. Shuruaat achhi hai.
Thanks? Mujhe? Galti se bol diya hoga! Chal khair... welcome. Par yeh dosti nahi hai, samjha?
Shukriya kis baat ka? Abhi toh maine kuch kiya hi nahi... ruk, kuch karta hoon.
Race? Chal! Main apni Mustang mein, tu apne Tesla mein. Bas beech mein charging ke liye mat rukna!
Udne wali gaadi? Bhai udega toh traffic police challan kahan bhejegi? Badalon pe?
Speed ka shauk hai? Mere spikes pe aa, ek second mein zero ho jayegi teri speed!
Kyun? Kyunki jab se tu aaya hai, mere pump pe line chhoti ho gayi hai. Dhanda hai bhai, dushmani nahi... thodi si hai.
Nafrat nahi hai {p}... darr hai. Agar sab bijli pe chale gaye, toh Gotiya kahan jayega?
Mere daadaji ne yeh pump banaya tha. Tera showroom dekhta hoon toh lagta hai unki yaadein bujh rahi hain.
Kilein? Kaunsi kilein? Mujhe kya pata... sadak pe apne aap ugg aayi hongi. Mausam hai.
Hatwa le khud! Depot mein jaa, counter khareed, aur meri mehnat pe paani pher de. Tujhe yahi toh aata hai.
Business hai bhai. Tu customer khinchta hai, main sadak rokta hoon. Dono apna apna kaam kar rahe hain.
Dhamki?! Mujhe? Mere paas Monster Truck hai, tere paas kya hai? Charger ka taar?
Ha ha! Darr gaya main... dekh, kaanp raha hoon. Dhuein se, darr se nahi.
Pyaar?! Arre baba... main shaadi-shuda aadmi hoon, aur meri pehli mohabbat diesel hai.
Chai? Haan! Kadak, adrak wali, aur saath mein samosa. Bijli se bani chai mein woh baat kahan.
Bhook lagi hai? Mere dhaabe pe aa, paratha khila dunga. Bas Tesla bahar park karna, ghee mein charge nahi hoti.
Meri biwi kehti hai Tesla le lo. Mere bachche kehte hain Tesla le lo. Sirf main kehta hoon... nahi. Akela hoon, par diesel hai.
Ghar? Ghar mein sab theek hai. Bas mera beta ab cycle chalata hai, kehta hai pollution kam karna hai. Haaye.
Cricket? Main toh tere showroom ke bahar fielding laga ke baitha hoon. Har customer catch karunga!
Sun ek joke: Tesla wala petrol pump pe aaya. Maine poocha kya chahiye? Bola: bas charger ka rasta. Hahaha!
Joke? Tera electricity bill hi sabse bada joke hai. Main roz padhta hoon, roz hasta hoon.
Ek baar ek Cybertruck ne aaina dekha... aaina bola: bhai pehle khud ko unfold kar!
Mausam? Garmi mein mera engine garam, sardi mein mera dil garam. Tera Tesla? Dono mein battery kam!
Yeh sab ek game hai kya? Agar hai, toh main villain hoon... aur villain sabse achhe dialogue bolta hai!
Haan? Kis baat pe haan? Main ne toh kuch poocha hi nahi... ya poocha tha? Dhuein mein yaad nahi.
Na? Theek hai, na sahi. Gotiya ko na sunne ki aadat hai... customers roz sunate hain.
Sawaal pe sawaal! Main Gotiya hoon, Google nahi. Par jawab hamesha ek hi hai: diesel best hai.
Achha sawaal hai {p}. Itna achha ki main iska jawab apne vakil se poochh ke dunga.
Pata nahi. Aur pata hota bhi toh nahi batata. Competition hai bhai, competition!
Hmm... soch raha hoon. Soch raha hoon. Nahi, kuch nahi aaya. Chai ke baad poochna.
Hmm, '{w}'... interesting. Yeh main apni diary mein likh raha hoon, agle sabotage ke liye.
Tu bolta bahut achha hai {p}. Isi liye toh meri dukaan tere showroom ke saamne hai... jasoosi ke liye.
Dekh, main shaant hoon. Par mere andar ka engine garam hai. Dhuaan nikal raha hai, dekh!
Accha accha, sun liya. Ab tu meri sun: level {lv} pe aa ke bhi tu mere dhuein ke aage kuch nahi!
Itni baatein? Mere customers bhi itna nahi bolte. Woh bas aate hain, dekhte hain, aur tere paas chale jaate hain.
'{w}'? Yeh shabd mere dadaji ne kabhi nahi bola. Woh sirf 'tank full' bolte the.
Main sun raha hoon {p}... ek kaan se. Dusre kaan mein meri Mustang ka engine baj raha hai.
Haan haan, bilkul. Waise... tu kabhi akela mehsoos karta hai? Kuch nahi, bhool ja maine kya poocha.
Abhi koi museebat nahi hai... matlab abhi tak. Customers ko khush rakh, gaadi chala, paise jod. Main dekh raha hoon!
Theek hai, bata deta hoon: Depot mein Jump Hydraulics aur Armor Tires khareed, right-click kar ke laga. Meri kilein bekaar. Haaye!
Andhera hai na? Depot se Solar Roof aur MegaPack le, laga de. Bijli wapas. Mujhe kyun pooch raha hai yaar!
Barricade? Beast Ram Mode khareed, Cybertruck mein baith, V daba ke zor se thok de. Mera cement... sniff.
GPS jam hai? Starlink aur Billboard pack le, phir highway ke teen billboard pe apna ad laga. Mera dhanda chaupat.
Mere truck se bachna hai? Chhat pe laal Roadster hai. Space se ud, aur R daba ke EMP maar. Ya phir type kar slash destroy... nahi nahi, mat karna!
Tu... tu sach mein aisa soch raha hai? Kisi ne itne saalon mein mujhse aise baat nahi ki.
Hmm. Pata nahi kyun, aaj kilein bichhane ka mann nahi kar raha. Tu ajeeb aadmi hai, {p}.
Dosti? Mujhse? Seth Gotiya se? Ruk... aankh mein dhuaan chala gaya. Bas dhuaan hai, aansu nahi.
Sach kahun? Main thak gaya hoon ladte ladte. Par mera pump... mere daadaji ka pump...
Tu mujhe maaf kar raha hai? Itne spikes ke baad bhi? Hmm... soch ke bataunga. Dil se nahi, dimaag se.
Theek hai {p}... haath mila. Aaj se Anant and Gotiya Motors! Tu bijli la, main customers laata hoon. Aur chai bhi!
Yaar, ladai mein kuch nahi rakha. Chal saath mein kaam karte hain. Mere pump pe charger lagwa de... naya zamana!
Partner! Aaj teen customer bheje tere paas. Commission ki baat baad mein, pehle chai.
Socha nahi tha main Tesla bechunga. Par dekh, Cybertruck ke saath selfie bhi le li. Mast hai!
Haan partner, bol! Jo bhi kaam ho, Gotiya hazir hai. Bas mujhe bijli ka jhatka mat dena.
Kal raat maine apni Mustang ko bataya ki hum partner hain. Woh naraz hai, par main khush hoon.
Tere saath kaam karke pata chala: dushman se achha partner hota hai. Aur paisa bhi zyada hai!
Meethi baatein band kar. Gotiya itni aasani se nahi pighalta. Pehle mera dil jeet, phir dukaan.
Haha! Maine saari sadak pe KILEIN bichha di, dono taraf! Ab dekhta hoon kaunsi Tesla test drive pe jaati hai!
Bijli ka main switch mere haath mein hai! Khatak! Ab andhere mein showroom chala, {p}!
Concrete ke barricade, poori sadak pe, dono taraf! Dekhta hoon ab tera Cybertruck kaise nikalta hai!
Cybercab ka GPS jam! Ab tera robotaxi gol gol ghoomega, jaise shaadi mein dulha ki ghodi!
BAS! Ab bahut ho gaya! Meri Monster Truck ready hai! Showroom ko mitti mein mila dunga! BOOM BOOM!
Mere spikes... mere pyaare spikes! Kisne hata diye? Sniff... wapas do mere kile!
Solar roof?! MegaPack?! Mera blackout... meri mehnat... Hai Ram! Mere switch ka kya kasoor tha!
Mera barricade! Paanch saal ka cement, ek Cybertruck ne tod diya! Baah baah baah!
Starlink?! Billboard?! Mere saare customers udhar ja rahe hain... mere paas koi nahi... Mummy!
NAHI! Mera truck band ho gaya! Meri Monster Truck ki aatma bijli ke jhatke se chali gayi... hoo hoo hoo!
Monster Truck, aage badh! Kaanch ka showroom toh mere liye bas ek bada sa biscuit hai!
Crunch crunch! Aaj showroom ko chai ke saath khaunga!
Udne wali gaadi se EMP maarega? Pehle meri truck ke tyre se bach ke dikha!
Truck ka ek tyre tere poore gate se bada hai! Dhaaaam!
Diesel ki shakti! Dekh mera dhuaan, aasmaan tak jaata hai, tere rocket se pehle!
HAHAHA! Mera Monster Truck jeet gaya! Tera showroom ab kabaadi hai, {p}!
Arre {p}, level {lv} pe pahunch ke itna ud raha hai? Gotiya ke aage sab chhote hain!
Tera showroom chamak raha hai... par chamak ke neeche meri saazish tik tik kar rahi hai.
Dekh, mere paas bhi naya stock aaya hai. Tera ek customer mere paas aaya, aur waapas nahi gaya!
Aaiye aaiye! Gotiya Petrol Motors! Aaj ka offer: ek litre petrol pe ek litre hawa bilkul free!
Kal raat sapna aaya: ek Tesla mere pump pe aayi aur boli, uncle thoda diesel dena. Maza aa gaya!
Gotiya Petrol Motors: jahan har tank mein zindagi hai, aur har customer ke paas bahaana.
Ek Tesla ki keemat mein main poore mohalle ko diesel pila sakta hoon... aur chai bhi!
Dhuaan dhuaan dhuaan! Meri kismat bhi dhuein jaisi hai: upar uthti hai aur sabko dikhti hai.
Suno suno! Jo Lamborghini dekhne aayega, usko garma garam chai free. Tesla wale ko thanda paani.
Mere showroom ki lights dekh! Bijli ki gaadi wale se zyada bijli toh main jala raha hoon. Irony!
Arre arre... main toh bas rasta dekh raha tha! Bhaago!
Kuch nahi dekha maine. Kuch nahi. Bye!
Oye peeche mat aa! Main ja raha hoon, ja raha hoon!
Bas window shopping kar raha tha yaar, itna gussa kyun?
Tera showroom dekhne nahi aaya tha... apna chashma dhundh raha tha!

Main customer hoon aaj! Dikha, sabse sasti Tesla kaunsi hai? Haha, mazaak kar raha hoon.

Bas ghoom raha hoon. Dekh raha hoon tu itne customers kahan se laata hai. Note kar raha hoon!
Haath mat laga! Pehle paise dikha, phir Lamborghini ki chabi!

Pasand aayi? Le ja! Bas ek shart: Tesla ka showroom band kar de. Haha!
Tu upgrade karega toh main bhi karunga! Dekh mera showroom: nayi lights, nayi gaadi, naya Gotiya!
Naya level? Mubarak ho. Maine bhi apni dukaan mein Lamborghini khadi kar di. Ab bol!
Gold ki patti, neon ki batti, aur Mustang ki garmi! Gotiya Motors ab level up!
Spotlight laga di maine chhat pe. Ab raat ko bhi sheher ko pata chalega asli dukaan kaunsi hai!
Ek aur bik gayi! Dekh {p}, petrol ki demand abhi zinda hai!
Cash payment! Na EMI, na charger. Yeh hota hai business!
Hahaha, mera customer muskura ke gaya! Tere customers toh charging ka intezaar karte hain.
Meri dukaan... meri gaadiyan... sab khatam. Daadaji, maaf karna. Main haar gaya.
Tune sab tod diya {p}... ab main kahan jaun? Koi toh kuch bolo...
